$comment: requires_bootstrap is the newest bootstrap call shape this plugin makes: bootstrap_lib.skill_material (bootstrap 0.138.0), reached through completion.skill_context. The codex text-only mode passes build_codex_exec_argv(ignore_user_config=True), a keyword first shipped in bootstrap 0.146.0, which is the floor. The venv exists for the CLI, not for the library: models.resolve_endpoint() reads layered config through bootstrap_lib + PyYAML, and OpenAI-compatible completion commands require the OpenAI SDK. The standalone Python carries only .pth links and no third-party packages. bootstrap_lib is linked in because config_resolve lives there. Under a claudx session (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_TEST set) ClaudeCliBackend imports bootstrap_lib.claudx lazily and inserts its --plugin-dir flags into the claude -p argv; outside claudx that module is never imported, so this adds no requires_bootstrap floor (nested claude children, engine-internals.md).
